name: recoil_app_fatal_error_and_exit
description: RecoilApp::FatalErrorAndExit ignores non-fatal codes and, for -1, localizes the fatal caption/text, shuts down subsystems, reports the error, and exits through the recovered cleanup path.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x430c90 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.

The native smoke patches only the smoke process: zLoc::GetMessageString, subsystem shutdown callees, and zSys::ExitProcessWithCleanup are redirected with temporary code jumps; Sleep, MessageBeep, and MessageBoxA are patched through import slots; all patches are restored before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x430c90 validates the early return for error codes other than -1, localized message ids 0x12 and 0x30 copied into 0x80-byte stack buffers, subsystem shutdown order, printf("%s: %s\n"), Sleep(1000), MessageBeep(MB_ICONHAND), MessageBoxA(g_RecoilApp_hWndMain, text, caption, MB_ICONHAND), and zSys::ExitProcessWithCleanup(0).
The native smoke verifies the non-fatal early return and the fatal path call order and provider arguments without sleeping, showing a modal dialog, or terminating the test process.
